meta.description: Mystic absorb names, granted arts and documented boosts

layout.basis: The nine bytes at tribial_work.data[4..12] decode as enemy id, stat mask and boost amount per weapon, and reproduce all 12 documented INIT absorbs for Ildon, Zozma, Rei and Silence, including their variant rows. See runbook 4.18.

meta.name_note: names and granted arts are the guide's extracted data, not save fields. Art names use the ability_names.json spelling; the guide's spelling differs in case for 13 slots (ThunderBolt, QuickSand).
meta.null_note: A stat missing from normal or variants means the guide prints a dash: the absorb gives no boost to that stat. Gunfish is the example: its normal row is empty, while Silence's INIT variant grants STR/QUI/WIL.
meta.source_section: [MYSAB02] Mystic Absorbs Data, Full Entries List
meta.variant_note: variants are the guide's documented INIT and Possession overrides. The save stores the resulting mask and amount, so the viewer compares the stored values with normal and with each variant instead of guessing which one applied.
